title: Nose Thief
premise: A snowman sneezes his carrot nose off. A rabbit catches it and bolts. The snowman chases it, hopping, with no legs.
visual: Snowy park. A snowman mid-hop, coal mouth in a furious frown, empty nose hole, scarf flying. Ahead a rabbit sprints with the carrot held like a relay baton. Snow puffs at every hop.
characterLean: Holiday-ready cutaway. Nobody explains how the snowman can move.

motion: 6-8s. Ah-choo. Carrot flies. Rabbit catches it mid-air and runs. Snowman hops, hops, hops after it. The loop resets when the rabbit runs past the camera again.
notes: Coal-eyebrows sell the anger. The rabbit takes one bite while running.
